summary.tldr: Requires the Health Minister to develop and report on a national ADHD framework for support, training and access to care.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of Health to work with provinces, Indigenous governing bodies and other stakeholders to develop a national framework on attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
Requires the framework to include resources that help people with ADHD and their families better recognise, understand and manage the disorder.
Requires the framework to include training and resources for educators, medical and mental health practitioners, including support for evidence-based assessment and treatment.
Requires the framework to aim to improve access to trained medical and mental health practitioners for people with ADHD and their families.
Requires the Minister to table the framework in both Houses of Parliament within two years and publish it on the Department of Health website.
Requires the Minister to report later on how effective the framework is, with conclusions and recommendations, and to table and publish that report.
